From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: PeopleOps Consulting <consult@peopleops.com>, Helen Park <helen@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Peer benchmarking synthesis and pre-calibration packet

Team —

I pulled together the cross-team benchmark export and a short agenda for our calibration roundtable next week. Attachments: peer_benchmarking_raw.csv (raw bucketing + manager notes) and roundtable_agenda.pdf.

Goal for the session: reach consensus on how we compare equivalent roles across Eng/Prod/DS and identify up to 8 outlier cases that need HR sensitivity before final ratings are locked. Please do the following before Monday:

- Review the CSV and flag any rows where manager context seems missing. Add a one-line note in the "manager_notes" column.
- Bring 2 cross-team examples where you think the current band/score mapping is inconsistent (one on the conservative side, one on the permissive side).
- Read the short HR guidance doc I attached (hr_guidance_summary.docx) — it's a draft from PeopleOps.

I understand some cases are sensitive (org changes, recent promotions, mid-cycle role moves). If you have flagged sensitive cases, note them in the shared Drive doc instead of in-line in the CSV. Link is below.

We have 60 minutes scheduled on Monday (see calendar invite). Karthik/Olga — can you confirm you can open the CSV and that the mapping keys (role_family, level, comp_bucket) look right? Marcus — if you can pre-seed two examples in the Drive doc that would help speed things up.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, People & Talent
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Peer benchmarking synthesis and pre-calibration packet

Laura —

Got the files. I ran a quick normalization pass and attached three notes inline in the CSV (columns: norm_suggestion). Quick summary:

- For senior ICs across Eng/Product, titles diverged; I suggested mapping "Sr. Staff" variants to a single anchor for band mapping.
- Two cases where recent org moves (late Q3) weren't reflected — marked as sensitive.
- One outlier where comp_bucket looks mis-assigned (likely a payroll tagging issue).

Proposal for Monday: use a 3-step approach during the call — (1) anchor mapping agreement, (2) surface flagged sensitives for pre-check with PeopleOps, (3) vote on the remaining cases in 10-minute buckets.

I'll paste one example below (redacted):

- For two Product managers I suggested shifting anchor mapping down one slot pending validation of scope.

PeopleOps (cc) — can you confirm availability for a 15-minute private pre-check at 10:00am on Monday? If not, propose alternatives. I also attached a one-page note (HR intake) to help structure those pre-checks.

Subject: Summary: Monday calibration — anchors, pre-checks, and action owners

Thanks all for the quick reviews and the examples. Quick summary and decisions ahead of Monday's call:

- Pre-check: PeopleOps will run a 15-minute private pre-check for the 6 sensitive cases at 10:00am Monday (Owners: Olga + PeopleOps).
- Anchors: We agreed to adopt Karthik's normalization proposal as the starting anchor set for the call; the team will have the ability to vote to move specific anchors during the session. (Owner: Karthik)
- Outlier handling: Marcus will present EX-1124 and EX-1130 as the two seeded outliers we’ll discuss.
- Deliverables after calibration: updated CSV with final mappings, an exception log for HR, and a one-page summary for Execs. (Owners: Laura / PeopleOps)

Links: Drive folder (https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/peer-benchmarking-2027) — please drop final notes there immediately after the call so PeopleOps can prepare the exception log.

If there are any changes to availability for Monday, reply-all. Otherwise see you on the call.

Best,
Laura
Director, People & Talent
Redwood Inference
